subject: maths
question:
The bar graph given below shows the sales of books (in thousands) from five branches of a publishing company during two consecutive years 2015 and 2016.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/aba70b8bc08c3339a7bc7afcc0db47ae55891c28ea67e22bb5a12e4108abc51f.png] 

What percentage (rounded off to 2 decimal places) of the average sales of branches P1, P3 and P5 in 2016 is the average sales of branches P1, P2, P3 and P4 in 2015?
solution:
**Calculation:**

The average sales of branches P1, P3 and P5 in 2016

⇒ (120 + 110 + 96)/3

⇒ 108.66

The average sales of branches P1, P2, P3 and P4 in 2015

⇒ (85 + 78 + 100 + 90)/4

⇒ 88.25

According to the question, 

⇒ (88.25/108.66)× 100

⇒ 81.21%

**∴ The required answer is 81.21%.**
